name: Oyo Empire
notes: Robin Law, The Oyo Empire, c.1600-c.1836 (Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1977) — standard academic history, reconstructed from scarce written sources plus oral tradition. Probably West Africa's most powerful state through the late 17th-18th centuries; collapse/relocation to "New Oyo" at Ago-Oja associated with Aláàfin Atiba, 1820s-30s.
